GOV-F-003-S43.title: TTL Expiration and Recovery Logic Implementation
GOV-F-003-S43.description: Implement core backend logic to evaluate lock TTL expiry, mark locks as expired, and enable safe recovery by new owners. Include ownership validation, race condition protection, and idempotent recovery behavior.

GOV-F-003-S44.title: Lock Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
GOV-F-003-S44.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, renewal, expiration, ownership enforcement, and recovery scenarios. Validate behavior under concurrent access and failure conditions.
